name: hermes-os-control-plane
principle: Hermes is the ONIA operating system. Self-hosted tools are capabilities behind one control plane, not isolated panels.

current_vps.decision: Keep current VPS as core/control plane. Do not add Dify, Crawl4AI browser workers or mail delivery here.

control_tower.role: Executive and operations panel for status, migration, service ownership, requirements and next actions.

capabilities.role: database, auth, storage and internal memory
capabilities.next_action: Map apps and tables before exposing any public API.
Keep as execution engine; route approvals through Telegram/Hermes.
Connect public booking URL after domain and email notifications are stable.

capabilities.role: client inbox and WhatsApp support layer
capabilities.next_action: Decide WhatsApp Cloud/BSP cost before scaling client offers.
Create monitors for all private services and public domains.

capabilities.role: AI gateway, model routing and future cost controls
capabilities.next_action: Add budgets/logging before opening to more users.
Use through SSH tunnel until SSO/auth gateway exists.
Keep behind login; do not expose without auth proxy.
Wire research workflows into Hermes and n8n.

capabilities.role: sellable AI apps, RAG and workflow builder
capabilities.next_action: Use larger VPS; review compose ports and license boundaries.
Run as private worker with memory limits and domain allowlists.

capabilities.role: email QA and local SMTP testing
capabilities.next_action: Start only for testing forms, apps and templates.

capabilities.role: newsletter, mailing lists and campaign UI
capabilities.next_action: Configure SMTP only after domain, PTR, SPF, DKIM and DMARC are ready.

capabilities.role: actual mail delivery server if ONIA wants full self-hosting
capabilities.next_action: Do not share the main VPS IP; reputation risk is too high.

migration_streams.from: External AI chats and prompt tools

migration_streams.condition: domain, SMTP notifications and event templates

migration_streams.to: Listmonk first, Mautic later if automation needs grow

migration_streams.from: AI app builders and RAG prototypes
migration_streams.condition: minimum 8 vCPU / 24 GB RAM class VPS

recommended_new_requirements.label: AI worker VPS
recommended_new_requirements.use: Dify, Crawl4AI, Browser Use/Maxun tests and future RAG workers
recommended_new_requirements.provider_candidate: Contabo Cloud VPS 30 class or better

recommended_new_requirements.label: Mail delivery VPS/IP
recommended_new_requirements.minimum: 2-4 vCPU / 4-8 GB RAM / clean dedicated IPv4
recommended_new_requirements.use: Postal, Mailu or docker-mailserver only if ONIA accepts deliverability maintenance
recommended_new_requirements.provider_candidate: Separate Contabo/other VPS with editable rDNS/PTR

recommended_new_requirements.label: SSO/auth gateway
recommended_new_requirements.use: Protect Open WebUI, Uptime Kuma, Listmonk, Dify and docs before public DNS

recommended_new_requirements.label: DNS and email reputation
recommended_new_requirements.minimum: A, MX, PTR/rDNS, SPF, DKIM, DMARC, bounce mailbox, unsubscribe policy

recommended_new_requirements.label: Offsite backups
recommended_new_requirements.minimum: Object storage or second VPS backup target
recommended_new_requirements.use: Supabase, n8n, Listmonk, Dify volumes and Hermes docs

tool_decisions.listmonk: Recommended first for ONIA newsletters and simple campaigns because it is lightweight and self-hosted.
tool_decisions.mautic: Use later only if ONIA needs full lead scoring, landing pages, campaign journeys and CRM-like marketing automation.
tool_decisions.postal: Best fit when ONIA needs a self-hosted SendGrid/Mailgun-like delivery platform, but only on a separate IP with strict DNS/reputation work.
tool_decisions.mailu_or_docker_mailserver: Use for mailbox-style mail server needs, not as the first campaign sender.
tool_decisions.mailpit: Use immediately for safe email QA before real sending.
